{{Quote|No bounty hunter that set out after the Bando Gora has ever returned!|[[Rozatta]]|<ref name="SW:BH" />}}
The '''Bando Gora''' was a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] cult on [[Kohlma]], a moon of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bogden/Legends|Bogden]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. The Bando Gora were located in a [[Bando Gora citadel|vast citadel]], where they employed mind-altering neurotoxins—developed and conditioned to suppress individuality and free will&mdash;and used [[The Force/Legends|Force]] abilities to turn these drug addicts into a mindless [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Bando Gora/Legends|slaves]] and [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]].

[[Dark Jedi/Legends|Fallen Jedi]] [[Komari Vosa]] became the [[High Priestess/Legends|High Priestess]] at some point, whose influence reached across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], often [[Death/Legends|killing]] those who stood in their way or refused to convert and became a horrific icon of terror and intrigue, especially within the criminal underworld.

==History==
{{Quote|The Bando Gora has become a dangerous parasite. It must be eradicated.|Darth Sidious to Darth Tyranus|audio=BandoGoraParasite-SWBH.flac|<ref name="SW:BH" />}}
The Bando Gora was born as a mysterious cult on [[Kohlma]], a moon of [[Bogden/Legends|Bogden]]. The moon had been turned into a massive graveyard after a terrible war on the planet, with ships bringing thousands of bodies to the mass graves. A band of grave robbers eventually joined forces and formed the Bando Gora, which comprised skilled assassins who became known as some of the most ruthless in the galactic underworld.

The cult ruled through fear in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] and uncivilized worlds in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], often [[Death/Legends|killing]] those who stood in their way or refused to convert. While they specialized mainly in terrorism and assassination, they were also involved in the trafficking of narcotics to fund their operations.  Their ruthless assassinations began crippling the galaxy's most powerful industries. Shortly after the [[Battle of Galidraan]], the cult attacked the planet [[Baltizaar/Legends|Baltizaar]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] requested [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] intervention, but the Jedi were under-prepared to face the power of the Bando Gora. The Jedi were almost overwhelmed, and many died, but the cult was eventually driven off.

One unauthorized member of the Jedi task force was [[Komari Vosa]], who was captured by the cult with two others and brutally tortured. Succumbing to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], she broke free and slaughtered both her captors and fellow captives before taking leadership of the cult.

[[File:Bandogoracaptain.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Unidentified Bando Gora captain|Bando Gora captain]]]]
Members of the cult became hideous, with [[Color/Legends|black]] mottled skin and glowing red or blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Bando Gora captains usually wore terrifying masks with long, downward horns and carried staffs which emitted green balls of fire. Shortly after the Battle of Naboo, the Bando Gora produced a potent strain of [[Death stick/Legends|death stick]] which contained even more powerful narcotics and was used to help brainwash victims. The narcotics also decreased their intelligence, essentially making them into mindless automatons that existed simply to serve Vosa's deranged will.<ref name="BH">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>

Forming an alliance with [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii the Elder]], and [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]], the corrupt king of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], the Bando Gora helped stage an [[Bombing of Sojourn|attack]] on [[Sojourn (moon)|Sojourn]], the fortress of Sith Lord [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] and an enemy of Veruna's. Secretly, the assassination attempt had been organized by Plagueis's apprentice, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. The Dark Lord had sent his apprentice, [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], to the prison of [[Cog Hive Seven]] to find a reclusive and influential arms dealer named [[Iram Radique]] and [[Mission to Cog Hive Seven|acquire]] the [[Nuclear weapon/Legends|nuclear bomb]] he was developing inside the prison. However, Radique's hatred of the Bando Gora (who had tried to kill him once in the past) made the attempt to broker the deal all the more difficult. Eventually, however, Maul killed Radique and the bomb was delivered to the Bando Gora. They later used it to destroy Sojourn. Plagueis escaped, however, with help from Gardulla's rival, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. Following the attack, revenge was meted out by the Sith Lord: Darth Maul was sent to wipe out Black Sun's leadership, Plagueis personally dealt with Veruna, and Gardulla's fate was left for Jabba to decide. The Bando Gora escaped the wrath of the Sith, however.

After Darth Plagueis's death at Sidious's hands during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Naboo crisis]], the new Dark Lord of the Sith began to consider the Bando Gora to be a dangerous threat and feared what they could do with a former Jedi like Komari Vosa as their leader. He instructed his new apprentice, [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]], Komari Vosa's former Jedi Master, to have her executed and the cult destroyed so it couldn't threaten their [[Grand Plan/Legends|long-term plans]].

Dooku hired [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and [[Montross (bounty hunter)|Montross]] to track down Vosa for a sum of 5 million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Republic credits]], an offer few could refuse. After chasing the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] down to [[Kohlma]], the burial moon of [[Bogden/Legends|Bogden]], and defeating his rival, Fett penetrated [[Bando Gora citadel|Vosa's heavily defended fortress]] and engaged her in a furious battle. He finally bested Komari, but spared her life. Dooku, who somehow seemed to be present, had other ideas and used the dark side to [[Telekinesis/Legends|choke]] her to death, decapitating the Bando Gora cult and ending their reign of terror. He revealed that he knew the location of Vosa all along, that this was a test and made an agreement with Jango for him to become the template for a [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|clone army]].

==Religion and philosophy==
{{Quote|I once tried to resist. But the Bando Gora have ways of weakening your mind and breaking your will.|Komari Vosa|<ref name="SW:BH" />}}
The Bando Gora practiced [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark arts]] and were particularly dangerous due to their use of a mind-controlling substance, which turned individuals into loyal, [[Bando Gora/Legends|mindless followers]] who obeyed without question.<ref name="SW:BH" />
